# Hobbies

## Free diving

Hana free dives on weekends. Her personal best is 32 metres in constant weight. She trains with a buddy and never dives alone. She started in 2019 after a beginner course in the Gulf of Oman.

## Training log

Monday is a breathing day. Hana sits for twenty minutes and practises slow nasal breathing with long pauses at the end of each exhale. She counts the pauses and writes the number in a small notebook. Tuesday is a dry day. She walks fast for forty minutes and then does a series of static holds on the living room floor. The holds start at one minute and grow by ten seconds each week. Wednesday is for flexibility. She stretches her ribs and shoulders, because a stiff chest costs her depth. Thursday is rest. She drinks water, eats rice and eggs, and goes to bed early. Friday is a pool session. She swims lengths underwater with a monofin and rests for two minutes between sets. Saturday is open water. The group boards a small boat at sunrise and dives until the wind picks up. Sunday is for notes. Hana reads the week back, marks what felt easy, and plans the next week in pencil. She keeps every notebook on a shelf above the desk. The oldest one has a coffee ring on the cover and a drawing of a turtle on the first page. She says the turtle is the real coach, because it never hurries and always surfaces calm.

## Baking

Hana bakes sourdough on Sundays. The starter is called Gustav and is four years old.
